mostWorthwhile.text: Clearing debris and then fitting the surface, support and blood supply made the different parts of wound repair understandable as one connected process.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to add the new surface before clearing debris was frustrating: the game did not explain that prerequisite until afterward.

surprise.text: I expected the new surface to fit immediately, but clearing debris first revealed the three repair slots.

arbitrary.text: The debris-clearing prerequisite felt somewhat arbitrary because the new surface was already shown spanning the gap, although clearing fragments had an understandable purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to try another chapter: putting the different repairs together was satisfying, even though the hidden prerequisite interrupted the flow.
